svg.title: Accelerator accelerator architecture
svg.desc: Two-queue gem5 integration with private 8 KiB L1I and 16 KiB L1D, DMA-coherent local crossbar and split TCM. All accelerator cache and DMA events stay on queue 1.

g.text: One gem5 process · two host simulation threads
CPU, caches and DMA schedule local events
Host ports and retries stay on queue 0
Accelerator state and callbacks stay on queue 1
Global synchronization every Q ticks · Q ≤ every crossing’s minimum modeled delay · include credits
